The BLT package provides helper functions to work with time series data on bacon, lettuce, and tomatoes. 


```{r setup}
library(BLT)
library(ggplot2)
```


One function is `AR1()`,

```{r}
AR1(bacon$value)
AR1(lettuce$value)
```

We also might want to know the percentage of NAs in our time series,

```{r}
bacon |>
  perc_missing_tidy(value)

lettuce |>
  perc_missing_tidy(value)

tomatoes |>
  perc_missing_tidy(value)
```

So, lettuce has the greatest percentage of missing data. 

```{r bacon_timeseries}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(bacon) +
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = value))
```
